subtitles.en: You're taken the earnings from C-A-T-L, first and foremost. Yeah, thanks for having me here.

subtitles.zh: 老实说，业绩低于市场预期，也低于我的预期。

subtitles.en: So the revenue is actually well on track. Actually, we see it's in line with the shipment growth.
subtitles.zh: 营收其实符合预期，与出货量增长一致。

subtitles.en: However, what has been missing the market expectation would be the bottom line. Where we see it's a decline in the quarter of a quarter.
subtitles.zh: 然而，不及市场预期的是净利润，我们看到环比下降。

subtitles.en: So I want to highlight a couple of potential reasons. So first, the changes in the revenue mix
subtitles.zh: 我想强调几个潜在原因。首先，营收结构变化。

subtitles.en: as the management also commented on the NS code that they shipped more so-called low value at products or solutions during this quarter.
subtitles.zh: 管理层在业绩会上提到，本季度出货更多低价值产品。

subtitles.en: So we actually believe that could be the domestic energy storage market, which is quite competitive right now with very fierce price competition.
subtitles.zh: 我们认为这可能是国内储能市场，目前竞争激烈，价格战激烈。

subtitles.en: So that margin is actually below its average margin level. And secondly, I want to highlight that there is some text change.
subtitles.zh: 因此利润率低于平均水平。其次，我想强调一些税收变化。

subtitles.en: Starting from April, there is a cut in the export VAT text refund rates.
subtitles.zh: 从4月开始，出口增值税退税税率下调。

subtitles.en: So it is not fully reflected in second quarter because there is a time difference between the shipment and actual revenue cognition.
subtitles.zh: 由于出货与实际收入确认存在时间差，二季度未完全反映。

subtitles.en: And now it's fully reflected in Q3. And also starting from September, China starts to levied the 2% battery consumption tax on all the domestic battery sales.
subtitles.zh: 现在三季度已完全反映。此外从9月起，中国对国内电池销售征收2%消费税。

subtitles.en: That's well list to extra text burdens on all the battery suppliers. So all this combined, I guess, the combined impact is just the bigger than the market expected.
subtitles.zh: 这给所有电池供应商带来额外税收负担。综合影响大于市场预期。

subtitles.en: Previously, market makes back some shares sharing between the battery suppliers and the car makers in terms of the extra text burden.

subtitles.zh: 但至少三季度尚未发生，可能还需进一步谈判，或许在明年四季度。

subtitles.zh: 我预计2027年这里的发行规模也会很大。人工智能是否仍将是推动这一趋势的领头羊？

subtitles.en: We've been talking about data centers, right? Given what we saw from Ellis yesterday. This is not really a well known company.

subtitles.en: It could still send shivers across the AI space here right now. Then you had the likes of firmness just a few weeks ago pulling that IPO in Australia and really looking maybe at the US market.

subtitles.en: I think this is certainly a time of a degree of caution. And I think what investors are really saying here is that they want to look at assets from a differentiated basis.
subtitles.zh: 我认为当前无疑是一个需要一定谨慎的时期。投资者真正想表达的是，他们希望以差异化的方式审视资产。

subtitles.en: So plenty of aspects of capital raising that could be via strategics, that could be via the private markets, that could be via IPOs as well.

subtitles.zh: 我认为所有这些路径仍然可行。问题在于，从估值角度看，我们最终会稳定在什么水平？对。
